اختلجن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَجْنَ (iḵtalajna) /ix.ta.lad͡ʒ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
# اِخْتَلِجْنَ (iḵtalijna) /ix.ta.lid͡ʒ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
